shared_frozen_assumptions.status: research spike only, not adopted, no live execution
shared_frozen_assumptions.instrument: Bitget BTCUSDT USDT-FUTURES linear perpetual, not spot
candidates: CASH: always cash, no assumed interest
HOLD: buy 90% of initial equity at first open then hold until end
T1: long when completed UTC daily close > SMA50 including that closed day, flat when below, equality preserves prior state
B1: long when completed UTC daily close > maximum high of prior20 complete UTC days excluding current; flat when close < minimum low of prior10 days excluding current; otherwise keep state
shared_frozen_assumptions.initial_state: T1/B1 start simulation according to causally precomputed daily state available at window start, using earlier data only as warmup. B1 state starts flat until first valid breakout. Fully complete contiguous UTC daily bars only. No price targets, trailing stops, shorts or pyramiding. Position may be held indefinitely until defined daily exit or test end.
shared_frozen_assumptions.sizing: At each flat-to-long entry, use <=90% of current equity for notional inclusive entry fee, floor quantity0.0001BTC; all entry funds are own cash. No borrowing, external funds, leverage. Hold fixed quantity between signals. HOLD same initial90%; CASH zero exposure. Actual realized exposures differ, compare them explicitly.
shared_frozen_assumptions.risk: No20USDT stop guarantee; original20 all-cost single-trade budget is not satisfied by these research hypotheses. Cash headroom=equity-minus-notional must remain>=0; if funding exhausts it, terminate INVALID_NO_LEVERAGE with true stop time; not exchange liquidation. Unknown historical contract/minimum order/margin rules preclude live suitability.
shared_frozen_assumptions.timing: Compute signal after complete UTC daily close. D0 execute immediately at next hourly open at that boundary. D1 execute one hour later. Initial window entry also delayed one hour in D1 for all noncash strategies. Next-open proxies are not actual :03 bid/ask. Delayed decision cannot change retroactively. Funding occurs before timestamp trades on previously held quantity.
shared_frozen_assumptions.fees: Taker0.0006 per side assumption; adverse spread/slippage combined0.0002 baseline,0.0005stress; not verified account fees. Same terminal liquidation fee/slippage for every held strategy.
